feasibility.title: Setup advisor
feasibility.intro: Find tooling changes with the full bend planner. Collision checks and limits stay enabled.

feasibility.graphic.title: Current die and required narrow-body concept
feasibility.graphic.description: The current {{current}} mm body is overlaid with a {{proposed}} mm concept. The hatched relief is {{side}} mm per side; the red marker is the reported collision location.
feasibility.geometry.spec: Tested concept: V{{v}} · {{angle}}° · R{{radius}} · H{{height}} · body {{body}} mm. First planner-passing width: {{boundary}} mm; the concept adds a 2 mm modelling margin.
feasibility.safetyBody: Select or engineer a manufacturer-rated tool; do not grind or modify hardened tooling. Verify the measured DXF profile, rating, mounting, clearance, guards and shop procedure, then re-run the simulation before production.
feasibility.dialog.fullPlan: Every bend and sequence was re-run with the normal collision sweep; no error collision remained.
feasibility.dialog.import: Obtain the rated tool drawing, import its measured DXF in Tools, mount that library item, and re-plan.
